comparator: Comment-only baseline patch on the identical base commit; no functional code changes
diagnostic_questions: Do the same 25 PASS_TO_PASS test IDs fail even in a comment-only patch?
If so, classify them as baseline/environment-associated rather than AI-introduced regressions
If no, classify the official AI candidate as additional test regression signal (not necessarily causal without stronger control)
admissible_claims: A comparison of named test failure sets for two patches on the same pinned benchmark task
Binary official label of the no-op comparator from executed suite
forbidden_claims: Causal regression attribution from unpaired runs
